description: This file contains source code for managing Wi-Fi radio interfaces, including configuration, status monitoring, and interactions with underlying hardware or driver functions. It defines many functions for radio parameters such as channel, bandwidth, power, modes, and event logging, indicating it handles the core logic related to Wi-Fi radio control within a driver or management layer.
